args:
**1. Validator name**
BonyNode

**2. Networks currently validating & AuM**
Professional node operator since 2017. 22 active validators across 50+ networks
(28+ mainnets, 22+ testnets) on dedicated bare-metal, including AtomOne.
AuM: ~$1M in delegations across all networks, largely from ecosystem developers.

**3. Digital presence**
Gno.land explorer (live): https://explorer.bonynode.online/gno
Website: https://bonynode.online/ | GitHub: https://github.com/BonyNode
X: https://x.com/bonynode | Telegram: https://t.me/bonynode
Discord: bonynode

**4. Contact**
Email: support@bonynode.online | Telegram: @bonynode | Discord: bonynode

**5. Why we want to validate on gno.land**
We already validate on AtomOne. Phase III of the Gno.land roadmap prioritises bridging
AtomOne and Gno.land over IBC/ICS, and the `10-gno` light client is already merged and
shipped on the AtomOne side - we want to be on both ends of that bridge when it lands.
Beyond that, Gno is the first chain where realms render their own UI, so an explorer can
show governance and the valoper registry natively rather than through a Cosmos skin.

**6. Contributions to gno.land**
- Public block explorer, live and free: https://explorer.bonynode.online/gno
  Built natively on Tendermint2 ABCI (vm/qrender, vm/qfuncs) - not a Cosmos-SDK skin.
  Shows blocks, live consensus round, the active valset with signing stats, a GovDAO tab
  with proposals and per-tier vote lists, the full r/gnops/valopers registry including
  operators still pending, and peer topology.
- Public RPC endpoints, free and open:
  betanet https://gno-rpc.bonynode.online | Topaz https://gno-topaz-rpc.bonynode.online
- Separate bare-metal nodes for betanet (gnoland1) and Topaz, each with its own
  consensus key - no key reuse across chains. Data-center hardware, not cloud, 24/7
  on-call, archive storage sized for gno.land's no-pruning model.
- Committed long-term, including IBC views once AtomOne <-> Gno.land IBC lands.
